name: fx-installments/api
description: FX Installments: USD price to local-currency installments, REST API and static-flow chatbot.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run php -l on every .php file under src/, tests/, bin/, public/ and db/.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Unit and Acceptance suites, with allow_url_fopen off and curl_exec/curl_multi_exec disabled (INV-06).
scripts-descriptions.acceptance: Run PHPUnit on the path given after --, with allow_url_fopen off and curl_exec/curl_multi_exec disabled (INV-06).
scripts-descriptions.test-guards: Run the git hook guard tests (needs sh).
